spans.s:
इलिनी इलिनी, f., N. of a daughter of
Medhātithi.

इली इली, f. a cudgel, a stick shaped like a
sword or a short sword. See ईली.

ईली ईली or ईलि, इस्, f. a weapon, sometimes
considered as a cudgel and sometimes as a short sword
or stick shaped like a sword.

इलीबिश इलीबिश, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a
demon conquered by Indra.

इल्लिश इल्लिश, अस्, m. the fish Clupea Alosa;
[cf. इलीश.]

ईलिन ईलिन, अस्, m., N. of a son of Taṃsu
and father of Dushyanta.
